meta.summary: Stable graph identifiers and reusable control mechanisms for SAP Sales, separated from process-variant codes.

attribution.preferred_citation: Dzmitryi Kharlanau. "SAP Sales Mechanism Library". CC BY-NC 4.0. https://dkharlanau.github.io/labs/enterprise-context/sales-processes/mechanisms/

provenance.policy: SAP public documentation verifies standard control behavior; memory hooks, graph decomposition, diagnostics and tests are independently authored.

code_system.rule: Process identifies the business branch; mechanism identifies a reusable decision/control engine; extension identifies the controlled change surface.

mechanisms.title: Item Category Determination
